propositions: Errored pairs are incorrectly scored as decision flips because the flip computation at parity.py:107 compares synthetic decisions from errored records without an errored guard, violating the documented contract that errored is not a model verdict.

A single transient error (e.g. ThrottlingException) on one arm fails the parity slot as a quality regression under criterion (b) because the fabricated flip is treated as never-acceptable, even though the same error is already separately gated under criterion (d).

The parity report cannot distinguish between real decision flips and fabricated flips from errors because errored_pairs is not tracked as a separate metric and excluded pairs are not visible in the gating-failure string.

An errored record with errored=True and valid=True produces a silent fabricated flip with no corroborating signal because the error does not affect the validity denominator, creating an undetectable regression.

The filed mechanism claiming the pair survives because 'dropped' is in _DECISIONS is incorrect; membership is decided by gold label at parity.py:105, not by decision value, so no decision vocabulary choice can prevent the pair from being counted as a flip.

The fix excludes gold pairs where either side has errored=True from decision_flips, adds errored_pairs to metrics and the gating string, and reads the errored flag directly rather than testing decision-vocabulary membership.
